raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Reversals arrive as separate rows with status 'REVERSAL' and an orig_txn_id. The silver filter keeps only status='POSTED', so it drops the reversal rows, while the original POSTED transactions stay in and inflate every gold total. The fix excludes POSTED transactions that a REVERSAL row points to.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.6,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions x WHERE x.status = 'REVERSAL' AND x.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id)"}}
